stdout_normalized:
usage: runtime/scripts/cli.py style check [-h]
                                          [--doc-type {report,gongmun,grant,minwon,contract,any}]
                                          [--pack {gongmun,minwon,hr,grant}]
                                          [--format {json,text}]
                                          file

positional arguments:
  file                  the document to check

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --doc-type {report,gongmun,grant,minwon,contract,any}
                        apply only the rules for this document type (default:
                        pack baseDocType, or all rules)
  --pack {gongmun,minwon,hr,grant}
                        apply a document-type rule pack in addition to ko-
                        style/1
  --format {json,text}  json (default, one document on stdout) or one line per
                        match
